content.scenario: A company is accused of violating consumer rights, and a complaint is filed. Which commission has jurisdiction to try the offence?
content.outcome: The offence can be tried summarily by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, save as otherwise provided.

user_queries: Which commission has jurisdiction to try consumer offences?
Can the District Commission try all consumer offences?
What is the role of the National Commission in trying consumer offences?
